todo:1.task_title: **Falling petals**: per-rose 60-120 small planes (halve on low-tier devices — see Execution strategy device tiers: low = innerWidth<768 || hardwareConcurrency<=4). Use canvas-generated 32x32 pink petal texture (two-color gradient). PlaneGeometry random size 0.04-0.09, random initial x/z/height, each frame falls vy 0.3-0.6 + sine horizontal drift + self-rotation, reset to top when y<-2. Prefer ONE InstancedMesh to control draw calls (or a pooled Mesh set if InstancedMesh proves complex — but InstancedMesh preferred).
